verses.t: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness
verses.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest

verses.t: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee

verses.t: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]
verses.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former

verses.t: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied
verses.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content

verses.t: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)

verses.t: And He found you lost and guided [you]
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)

verses.t: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)

verses.t: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]
verses.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away

verses.t: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]
verses.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse
